import hashlib, json, dataclasses
from pathlib import Path
import ida_bytes, ida_funcs, ida_name, ida_nalt, ida_segment, ida_ua, ida_ida, idautils, idc
outdir = Path('C:/Dev/Astra_A2WC511R/reports/local/ida')
rom = ida_bytes.get_bytes(0, 0x100000)
assert rom and rom[0x2000:0x2009] == b'A2WC511R\0'
result = {'metadata': dataclasses.asdict(db.metadata), 'input_path': ida_nalt.get_input_file_path(),
    'rom_sha256': hashlib.sha256(rom).hexdigest(), 'processor': ida_ida.inf_get_procname(),
    'big_endian': ida_ida.inf_is_be(), 'segments': [], 'functions': []}
for ea in idautils.Segments():
    seg = ida_segment.getseg(ea)
    result['segments'].append({'start': hex(seg.start_ea), 'end': hex(seg.end_ea), 'name': ida_segment.get_segm_name(seg)})
def disasm_window(start, end):
    lines=[]
    for ea in range(start,end,2):
        insn=ida_ua.insn_t()
        size=ida_ua.decode_insn(insn,ea)
        lines.append({'ea':hex(ea),'bytes':ida_bytes.get_bytes(ea,2).hex(),'code':ida_bytes.is_code(ida_bytes.get_flags(ea)),
            'size':size,'text':idc.generate_disasm_line(ea,idc.GENDSM_FORCE_CODE) if size else None})
    return lines
for start,end in [(0x147AC,0x14818),(0x15A02,0x15A2C),(0x15A2C,0x15D92),(0x24950,0x24AA4),
                  (0xAAC,0xC00),(0xF928,0x10000),(0xD270,0xD350),(0x121E0,0x122E0)]:
    f=ida_funcs.get_func(start)
    result['functions'].append({'requested':hex(start),'function':None if not f else [hex(f.start_ea),hex(f.end_ea)],
        'name':ida_name.get_name(start),'lines':disasm_window(start,end),
        'xrefs':[{'from':hex(x.frm),'type':x.type,'is_code':bool(x.iscode)} for x in idautils.XrefsTo(start)]})
(outdir/'initial_static_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2,default=str),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='functions'},default=str))
print('Function windows exported to initial_static_audit.json; no IDB edits.')
